name: the sky bridge over the busy road, with the castle-tower apartments on the mountain
about: The pedestrian sky bridge where the Kalimar path crosses a busy road, with its view of the tree-covered mountain and the castle-tower apartments; seen in chapters 1 and 32. The book gives only the details listed below; the rest of the design is invented, and contributors are welcome to replace it.

facts.quote: the houses soon gave way to thick green shrubbery
facts.fact: Thick shrubbery leads up to the bridge.

facts.quote: the path transitioned into a sky bridge above a busy road, with many cars and autobuses and a few autonomous delivery vehicles passing beneath him
facts.fact: The bridge crosses a busy road of cars, autobuses and autonomous delivery vehicles.

facts.quote: The busy road beneath him continued for about two kilometers, and then turned rightward.
facts.fact: The road runs straight about two kilometers, then bends right.

facts.quote: Beyond that point, he could see a mountain covered with trees.
A few apartment buildings about fifteen storeys tall, decorated and shaped like over-sized medieval castle towers though with far more windows on the sides
facts.fact: Fifteen-storey apartment towers shaped like oversized medieval castle towers, with many windows.

facts.quote: poked up high above the trees in several places on the lower half of the mountain slope
facts.fact: The towers rise above the trees on the lower half of the slope.

facts.quote: the road continued past the sky bridge with a much higher density of buildings
facts.fact: On the other side the road is lined with denser buildings.

facts.quote: a sky bridge overlooking a busy highway
facts.fact: The road is a busy highway.

facts.quote: After crossing the sky bridge, the road transitioned into a tunnel
facts.fact: Past the bridge the path enters a tunnel.

descriptor: a slender pedestrian sky bridge of pale sculpted stone with living planter rails, arching over a busy multi-lane road of small autonomous buses, cars and delivery pods that runs straight toward a tree-covered mountain, where fifteen-storey apartment towers shaped like oversized medieval castle keeps, studded with many windows, rise above the forest on the lower slopes, beneath a vast pastel sky with distant elegant megastructures
